data.content:
## Introduction

Portugal will play their first match since Cristiano Ronaldo’s international retirement when they host Denmark at the Estádio Municipal de Braga in the UEFA Nations League A on Saturday, 14 November 2026.

This Portugal vs Denmark match preview covers the latest team news, injury updates, probable line-ups, head-to-head statistics, betting odds and our prediction for the fixture. [...] Home
 Betting Tips

## Portugal - Denmark

UEFA Nations League

November 14, 2026 at 19:45 GMT+0000

# Portugal vs Denmark: Prediction, Team News & Lineups

Nikolaj Juul Nielsen   Nikolaj Juul Nielsen

Match: Portugal vs Denmark

Date/Time: Saturday, 14 November 2026 – 20:45 CET

Stadium: Estádio Municipal de Braga

Competition: UEFA Nations League A

## Introduction [...] On Monday, Rafael Leão, Tomás Araújo and Nuno Tavares all withdrew because of injuries. Meanwhile, Nuno Mendes and Matheus Nunes were left out of the squad.

Portugal will also be without Francisco Conceição and João Cancelo, who are both suspended for this fixture.

These absences have created opportunities for several players to enter the international picture. Six newer names have been called up, including António Silva, who is returning to the squad.

• Liechtenstein Initiative (United Nations Gen‐ eral Assembly Resolution 76/262, 2022): Requires the President of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) to convene a meeting within 10 working days whenever a veto is exercised, compelling the vetoing country to publicly justify its decision. [...] • Increasing Accountability: The Liechtenstein Initiative raises the diplomatic and political costs of vetoes by requiring permanent members to defend their decisions before the General Assembly.
Arguments Against Abolition • Great-Power Survival: The veto safeguards the participation of major powers in collective secur‐ ity arrangements. Binding action against their vital interests could undermine the organisa‐ tion's effectiveness. [...] • A heavily fortified, non-contiguous territ‐ orial exclave of the Russian Federation and its westernmost administrative region (Oblast), physically separated from mainland Russia by Belarus and Lithuania.
Geographical Location & Borders: • Location: Situated along the southeastern coast of the Baltic Sea in Northern/Eastern Europe.
• Land Borders: Wedged directly between two NATO and European Union member states— Poland to the south and Lithuania to the north and east.
